verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment listing 'protected branches' and 'code owners' as GitHub Team features on private repos. That confirms GitHub ships its own branch protection, but nothing documents what those rules can enforce. missing for 10: first-party documentation of branch protection rules or rulesets, required pull-request reviews before merge, required passing status checks before merge, tag protection, and any hands-on corroboration of enforcement.
